iis_flu_rate.long_name: Illinois I-CARE: Influenza vaccination rate by county, current season
iis_flu_rate.short_description: Percentage of Illinois residents vaccinated against influenza in the current season, by county.
iis_flu_rate.long_description: Percentage of the Illinois population vaccinated against seasonal influenza, by county, as reported to the Illinois Comprehensive Automated Immunization Registry Exchange (I-CARE). Data are extracted from the IDPH Influenza Vaccination Coverage dashboard (Tableau Server) and reflect cumulative coverage for the current flu season. The dashboard is a snapshot of current-season data; the time column reflects the end of the current flu season (May 31). Suppressed values (where indicated) have been flagged.
iis_flu_rate.statement: In {location}, {value}% of residents were vaccinated against influenza in the current season.

iis_flu_count.long_name: Illinois I-CARE: Number of influenza vaccines administered by county, current season
iis_flu_count.short_description: Number of influenza vaccines administered to Illinois residents in the current season, by county.
iis_flu_count.long_description: Count of influenza vaccines administered to Illinois residents, by county, as reported to the Illinois I-CARE registry. This is an integer count of doses, not unique individuals.
iis_flu_count.statement: In {location}, {value} influenza vaccines were administered in the current season.

iis_flu_pop.short_name: IL county flu vaccine denominator population
iis_flu_pop.long_name: Illinois I-CARE: Population denominator for flu vaccination coverage, by county
iis_flu_pop.short_description: Estimated total population used as denominator for flu vaccination coverage calculations, by Illinois county.
iis_flu_pop.long_description: County-level population estimates used as the denominator for flu vaccination coverage calculations in the Illinois I-CARE dashboard.

il_icare.name: Illinois Comprehensive Automated Immunization Registry Exchange (I-CARE)
il_icare.description: The Illinois I-CARE (Comprehensive Automated Immunization Registry Exchange) is the statewide immunization information system maintained by the Illinois Department of Public Health. The IDPH Influenza Vaccination Coverage dashboard provides county-level influenza vaccination coverage rates and counts for the current flu season, extracted via the Tableau Server CSV endpoint. Data reflect vaccinations reported to I-CARE by healthcare providers across Illinois. The time column represents the end of the current flu season (May 31).
il_icare.restrictions: Public domain. Illinois DPH data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
